title: Common-stage adic open extension comparison data
statement: For a finite comparison family and its ordinary common-stage section data over an independent-universe algebraic closure Omega, define common-stage open extension data. For every quasi-compact open immersion j over k include the actual compact-support coefficient action, an additive heart extension functor preserving finite limits and finite colimits, its natural identification with that action on all common-stage arrows, completed pullback, and their adjunction with invertible open unit. Include its coefficient-unit identification, finite-stage extension and restriction comparisons preserving both coefficient units and adjunction units, natural ordinary-section restriction with its Hom formula, natural inside comparisons for the specified actual adic fibres, and zero outside fibres. Define restriction of a unit morphism using the inverse open adjunction unit. These comparison data assert no existence. Use exactly [def-a1-finite-adic-compactification-section-data] [def-a1-common-adic-section-data] [def-weil-compact-support-coefficient-action] [lem-per-adic-heart-pullback-fibres]. Its ordinary restriction is tied by the Hom formula to the normalized finite-stage section maps, with all finite-stage unit and adjunction-unit equations retained.

source.place: Proposition 6.8.14(1),(2), Remark 6.8.15; comparison diagrams for Milne Definition 18.1 and Proposition 18.3(b).
